== Purpose ==
Formats a game or mod file path. '''pdxparse''' uses it in the
<code><nowiki><noinclude></nowiki></code> footer of generated templates to record
which script files a page was built from, e.g.

<pre>
Automatically generated from the file(s): {{path|common/opinion_modifiers/00_opinion_modifiers.txt}}
</pre>
